censoring_repair.reason: A grouped episode with at least one unobserved member end has no observed group completion, even if other members ended.

policy_only_comparison.selection_period: Only original policy month; test threshold never optimized.

plan.target: Unchanged grouped sensor proxy episode starts within [t,t+24h).

configs.recent_reference: Original features, fresher train ending 2 months before test; depth6/l2=8.
configs.sequence: Same fit plus 239 causal multi-resolution, variation and recurrence features.
configs.sequence_regularized: Sequence with depth4/l2=30 and 180-day training weight half-life.
configs.recurrence: Small model with calendar, static metadata and confirmed past episode history; depth4/l2=30.

plan.periods: Train until test-2mo (14mo for fault/fire/flood; from 2022 for access). Next 1mo early stopping; next 14d calibration; rest (~14-17d) policy. 25h purge each boundary.
plan.training: CatBoost Logloss, early stop PRAUC, max1000, patience100, lr.04, seed42, 4 CPU threads.
plan.policy: Search 3/6/12/24h cooldown only in policy period. Budget <=.25 false alerts/object/day. Maximize min(P/.75,R/.5,1), then recall, precision, F1; require >=10 alerts. If none satisfy alert count, mark unsupported and use closest supported-in-budget candidate without claiming success.
plan.row_policy: Separately choose maximum row Recall at empirical row Precision>=.75 and >=10 positive predictions on policy period. If unavailable, minimize proportional P/R deficit. This is a different unit from incident evaluation and never substitutes for it.
plan.selection: Choose best pooled event goal_score across two screening months. Require >5% relative score gain over recent_reference and event F1 not lower; then one May confirmation of chosen model vs reference. No June reads.
plan.confirmation: Candidate improves event goal_score on May and does not lower F1 >5%; report each P/R and support even if gate fails. No automatic deployment.
plan.attribution: Report both fixed24h and adaptive cooldown for every model; compare previous reference with policy-only adjustment separately.
plan.external_training_data: None; provided telemetry only; all weights trained from scratch.

plan.reason: Raw log inspection found device modes (arming, battery, pump/fan, persistent bad-state counts) not represented by the original aggregate features.
plan.features: 333 v6 features + 84 device-mode features. Canonical conflict handling; all observations strictly before t; per-year state reset. No label redefinition.

configs.device_catboost: v6 sequence fit (depth6, l2=8, max1000, lr=.04) with extra device state features.
configs.device_histogram: Sklearn histogram gradient boosting, 15 leaves, min_leaf=100, l2=10, max400, lr=.05, seed42. Early stop AP on explicit temporal validation, patience40. Four threads.
configs.device_loglinear: Signed log1p numeric values; training-only median imputation/missing indicators/standardization; categorical one-hot. L2 logistic C=.01, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=300, seed42. Four threads.

plan.periods: Identical to v6 periods: test-2mo train cutoff; validation1mo; calibration14d; policy remaining days; purge25h.
plan.policy: Identical to v6: joint P=.75,R=.5 goal score, FP budget, report both 24h and selected 3/6/12/24h cooldown; row policy separate.
plan.selection: Best pooled event goal_score on November/February, then event F1. Require >5% gain vs v6 recent_reference with no F1 loss. Compare selected candidate vs v6 reference on May only after selection; goal_score must improve and F1 cannot lose >5%. No automatic deployment.
plan.june: Excluded from all research reads. Original frozen files unchanged.

plan.hypothesis: A 3h grid/24h cooldown misses repeated episodes even with good ranking; evaluate hourly recalculation with independent preceding-period policy selection.
plan.unchanged: Same model weights, same calibration, same grouped episodes and 24h target. No resampling or synthetic training rows.
plan.cohort: Hourly forecasts only between consecutive eligible 3h opportunities (gap <=3h). Assert identical eligible episode count for each model/period. All shared-time feature columns must match exactly; shared-time probabilities must match archived values.
plan.policy: On each model's original policy interval only: compare 3h cadence (cooldowns3/6/12/24) with1h cadence(cooldowns1/2/3/6/12/24). Maximize min(P/.75,R/.5,1), then recall,precision,F1. False alerts <=.25/object-day; require10alerts; flag<10eligible episodes. Exposure uses actual cadence.
plan.selection: Choose best pooled hourly event goal_score over Nov/Feb, then F1. Confirm only that family's 1h vs3h version in May. Require >5% goal_score improvement on May and no >5%F1 loss; target achievement reported separately.
plan.june: Excluded; no changes to original June release or production.
plan.warning: Cadence/calculated-policy gains are not gains from model weights. More frequent warnings can increase workload; report alerts and lead time.

implementation_corrections.reason: Convert pandas Series to NumPy before max(initial=0). Failed before first policy selection/result; all experiment choices unchanged.

plan.hypothesis: Binary probability cannot distinguish one impending episode from multiple episodes. Count regression and a causal outstanding-warning budget may reduce duplicate false alerts while covering recurrent episodes.
plan.reference: v8 selected hourly classifier family for each kind; selection already completed before this study.
plan.training: Original v6 recent-reference features and time splits. CatBoost Poisson, depth6, l2=8, lr=.04, max1000, early stop Poisson100, seed42, CPU4. Count>0 must exactly equal original binary labels on all used rows.
plan.calibration: On separate calibration period: sigmoid of raw log rate for binary probability; mean-count multiplicative correction sum(observed)/sum(predicted).
plan.opportunities: Same hourly cohort as v8, same 24h event matching, 70min delay before a past episode can resolve a pending warning.
plan.policies: Two choices, selected on preceding policy period: ordinary probability threshold/cooldown1,2,3,6,12,24; pending budget emits if expected_count >= outstanding + margin and p>=floor. Margin .25,.5,.75,1,1.5,2,3; p floor0,.25,.5,.75. At most one warning/hour. Outstanding warnings expire after24h or resolve one-to-one to confirmed intervening episodes.
plan.selection: Best pooled goal_score over Nov/Feb, then F1; require >5% goal_score gain over v8 selected classifier and no F1 loss. Only passing kinds proceed to May; require improvement in goal_score and no >5%F1 loss. Targets .75/.5 reported separately. No automatic activation.
plan.not_claimed: This is neither a Hawkes/RPP likelihood implementation nor proof that episodes follow a Poisson process. Poisson is used as a nonnegative count regression loss.

limitations: Repeatedly used historical periods; May is a confirmation period, not a new blind test.
Cadence/threshold improvements are distinct from gains caused by model weights.
Proxy sensor episodes are not confirmed physical incidents.
Sparse fault/flood events and temporal drift limit conclusions.
Some loglinear fits reached the iteration limit without convergence.
Passing a relative-improvement gate does not imply reaching the P/R targets.
